connection_condition: Operating points are extracted from simulation_result's PSF data files
description: A simulation result contains multiple transistor operating points extracted from PSF STRUCT/OP blocks

connection_condition: gm is directly stored in PSF as <instance>:gm
description: Transconductance is extracted from transistor operating point, not computed from others

connection_condition: gm_over_id = gm / Id where both values exist in operating point
description: gm/Id is computed by dividing transconductance by drain current from the same operating point

connection_condition: Vov = Vgs - Vth, requires both values from operating point
description: Overdrive voltage is derived from gate-source voltage minus threshold voltage

connection_condition: SKILL run() function returns path to resultsDir, which contains simulation_result
description: SKILL execution triggers simulation, and the result indicates success/failure of the simulation

connection_condition: Errors occur during SKILL execution and are captured in skill_result
description: Virtuoso errors may occur during SKILL execution and are captured in the result

connection_condition: Tunnel must be active before session can connect to remote Virtuoso
description: A session requires an active SSH tunnel when connecting to remote Virtuoso

connection_condition: Maestro sessions are bound to Virtuoso sessions via ADE Explorer
description: A Virtuoso session may contain multiple Maestro ADE sessions

connection_condition: Maestro runs simulation and produces simulation_result in resultsDir
description: A Maestro session runs simulations that produce simulation results

connection_condition: Schematic is netlisted and simulated to produce results
description: Schematic cellview is translated to netlist and simulated to produce results

connection_condition: tran.tran files are PSF format containing transient data
description: Transient response is a specific type of PSF data from tran analysis

connection_condition: ac.ac files are PSF format containing frequency domain data
description: AC response is a specific type of PSF data from ac analysis

connection_condition: dc_op.dc files are PSF format containing DC bias values
description: DC operating point is a specific type of PSF data from dc_op analysis
